name: Video Prompting Guide
headline: Video Prompting Guide: AI Video Generation Best
short_description: This skill offers best practices for writing effective AI video generation prompts using inference.sh. It is designed for developers and content creators looking to enhance their video generation capabilities.
author: inference-sh-skills

sections.overview:
The Video Prompting Guide provides structured best practices for crafting effective prompts for AI video generation through inference.sh, supporting 40+ video models including Veo, Seedance, and Wan. It helps developers and content creators understand prompt engineering techniques specific to video generation, improving output quality and creative control. This guide is part of the inference.sh skills ecosystem, which offers access to hundreds of AI models through a unified CLI and agent interface. By following these prompting strategies, users can achieve more consistent, higher-quality video generation results across different models and use cases.
Generate cinematic video prompts
Create engaging video content
Automate video generation tasks
Improve video prompt writing skills
